rule: One fetcher per Tier-A publisher. Each picks the defining sentence first (relation_echo.define_rank); a gloss or a structured record is rendered deterministically as 'Label is definition.' with the verbatim text kept. A source is used only when its flag is on. Two independent trusted publishers must agree before anything is saved; this release writes nothing (dry-run only).

sources.note: facts pages; the first sentence that defines the subject is kept
planetary fact sheets: numbers only, so it answers 'what is the mass of X', never 'what is X'
same publisher as science.nasa.gov: never a second independent source for it
scope note of the preferred concept only; an entry term from a narrower concept is not the same meaning
The CIA ended The World Factbook on 2026-02-04; every cia.gov/the-world-factbook page now redirects to a farewell notice. Disabled. Anchors already stored from it stay pinned.
the seven SI base-unit definition pages (SI Brochure text, CC BY 4.0)
periodic table for elements; compound descriptions only from public-domain origins (LiverTox, HSDB). Same publisher as MeSH (NLM).
ChEBI definition through the EBI Ontology Lookup Service (exact label)
goldbook.iupac.org answers 403 (Cloudflare challenge) to a scripted fetch, page and /json alike. Disabled. Share-alike rows also need Nic's decision (D7) before any could be stored.
gloss of the pinned sense (data/concept_senses.json); an unpinned word with more than one noun meaning is not guessed (ask)
link and cross-check only: QID and description; never a source document, never counted as a publisher
